ANALYSIS: Lambert‑Eaton myasthenic syndrome is an autoimmune presynaptic neuromuscular junction disorder causing proximal muscle weakness and autonomic features (often paraneoplastic). Upper airway cough syndrome (postnasal drip) is an ENT cause of chronic cough. They are distinct entities with different pathophysiology, clinical presentations, and management.
